proofs.detail: RFC 3161 time-stamp of the manifest by FreeTSA (a free, community authority; complementary to the DigiCert time-stamp of the ledger).
proofs.verify_command: openssl ts -verify -data proofs/manifest.jcs -in proofs/freetsa.tsr -CAfile proofs/freetsa-cacert.pem -untrusted proofs/freetsa-tsa.crt

proofs.detail: The proof commits the manifest to Bitcoin block 976709. Check it on your own node: ots verify proofs/manifest.jcs.ots
